name: Murder Party
desc:
Murder. Law. Party. Chaos. Legend says they’ve been cursed to eternal struggle. If you want to discover the mystery, follow the round sheep. 🐑

How to Play:
😈 TEAM MURDER: Murder everyone. Don't get shot!
💻 TEAM CHAOS: Use your laptop to hack your way to victory.
🎉 TEAM PARTY: Start a party! If you can get everyone to party, you win.
🤠 TEAM LAW: Stop ALL other teams from winning.

Thank you for playing Murder Party!
